title: Why She Walked Away From Strictly After Two Wins | Break the Routine with Oti Mabuse (PART 2)
description:
In part two, Oti Mabuse looks back on every one of her Strictly partners, from Danny Mac to back-to-back wins with Kelvin and Bill Bailey, and tells her husband and host Marius Iepure why she walked away from the show at the top. She opens up about learning she could not work alone, the one question she now asks every celebrity, doing the show through lockdown, and giving so much of herself that she had nothing left to give and wanted a family life. Plus Dancing with the Stars in Ireland, building OMDS, and where competitive DanceSport is heading. An honest conversation about ambition, exhaustion and choosing what truly matters.

Episode out now on YouTube.
